strengths.text: Opening with the PEEL moment and 'no umm' made the parent feel his son was seen. You also matched his Hinglish naturally.
You turned the competitor comparison into a format question (peer audience vs 1-on-1) without criticising anyone.

fixes.text: Only quote competitor comparisons you can back with data.
fixes.better_line: Hamare yahan 6 bachon ka group hai, isliye har bache ko bolne ke liye audience milti hai. Aap fee ke baare mein jo humne bataya, usi se compare kar sakte hain.

fixes.text: Set a check-in time, and ask about the mother's 'after exams' view directly.
fixes.better_line: Sir, kya main kal subah 10 baje check kar loon ki payment ho gaya? Aur agar mummy ji ko kuch poochna ho, toh main unse bhi baat kar sakti hoon.

coaching.next_call_drill: Before the call ends, name the time you will check payment, and ask once about any family member who was mentioned.
